text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text: Huh, here already? Front row! Wait, at like every mock race? Crazy.
choice_data_list: I just really wanted to watch
I just really wanted to watch

text_block_list.text: Necessary step to find partner Uma Musume. Watching race notepad in hand... then one day——

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Begins special showdown! Pre-debut and debuted Uma Musume, plus special guest from overseas!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Phew. ...Alright!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: ——And start!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Scattered start. Delayed start, Almond Eye positioned 10 lengths behind lead——

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye monitors front. ——Now moving into final straight, first to make move is...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Right, heeeeeeeere!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Here comes Almond Eye! Almond Eye, Almond Eye! Can three in front hold attack? Little longer——

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: None hold back! Surging out front, runner from overseas! Pulls further, further ahead——goal in!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fourth...!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but against lineup... debuted girls plus overseas runner super tough. Fourth still great, right?
Generally rare for pre-debut Uma Musume to beat post-debut. Usually happy placing well——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Could not reach them at all...! Drive, stamina, none of it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Even though——should have done more...! ～～～Aaah, geez...!
——Next week's mock race.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa! Thanks for rematch!

text_block_list.name: Tiara-Seeking Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Likewise. But... hardly believe how much stronger you became in short time. Splendid victory.

text_block_list.name: Tiara-Seeking Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Someday payback for loss——in Twinkle Series. Let us meet again.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes, looking forward to it! To not lose, I will keep polishing strength!
Second place girl... defeated Almond Eye last week, if recalled correctly.
choice_data_list: (So she was able to get revenge)
(So she was able to get revenge)

text_block_list.text: Surprised by strong desire for victory. Following week——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Been while, Almond Eye here. Look forward to working together today!
Girl Almond Eye shook hands with was Senior-class Tiara Uma Musume lost to in mock race.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Will not let you pass! Just like this...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I will win———!
Tiara Uma Musume stayed second as Almond Eye pulled further away——overwhelming victory over opponent...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haa! Haa! Haa! ...Phew...! Really strong. But——I won...! I managed to win!
...Hard to believe running consecutive races. Brilliantly overcame rivals, showing incredible potential.
Rather than that, was she——
Not completely outside realm of possibility. Though last one overseas Uma Musume here only for previous event.
Level-wise, extremely hard to beat, probably back home now.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Good afternoon! Sorry so sudden. Talked at riverbank before, Almond Eye here. Well... favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Want to go overseas for revenge match. So... accompany me as chaperone while traveling...?
